name: reschedule_appointment

messages.content: Okay, let me move that for you.
Thanks for your patience, I'm still working on that.

description: Move one of the caller's own upcoming appointments to a new time the caller picked from get_available_slots. The appointment keeps its id; the old time is freed. The server re-verifies identity by phone number plus date of birth and only allows the caller's own appointments.

appointment_id.description: The appointment_id of the appointment to move, copied exactly from the VERIFIED result's upcoming_appointments.

slot_id.description: The opaque slot_id of the new time the caller chose, copied exactly from get_available_slots.

date_of_birth.description: The date of birth the caller stated to verify their identity, as MM/DD/YYYY.

phone_number.description: Only if there is no caller ID or the appointment is under a different number: the phone number on the patient's record. Omit to use the caller ID.
